title: Koca Mustafa Pasha Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Current named OpenStreetMap outline of the main building and courtyard entrance portico.

terrainReference.basis: Original ground level immediately north of the five-bay entrance portico.

mapIdentity.provider: Named current footprint with dimensions and historic exterior measured plan.
mapIdentity.scope: The named current outline measures 25.89 m along the east-west body and 21.93 m across. The historic measured plan locates the dome, converted north entrance, partly visible early eastern apse and western minaret relative to its outer walls.

note: Van Millingen’s 1912 field survey records the lead roofs, plain molded cornices, pale dressed stone elsewhere and alternating brick and stone in the drum. The Istanbul Governorship and Eyice document five surviving portico bays, the eight-sided drum, two semidomes and minaret details.
